Teams with most SB wins: Pittsburgh Steelers (6), New England Patriots (6), San Francisco 49ers (5), Dallas Cowboys (5), Green Bay Packers (4), Seattle Seahawks (1) but we need 6 teams with most wins. Actually ranking: Steelers 6, Patriots 6, 49ers 5, Cowboys 5, Packers 4, then next: New York Giants (4), Denver Broncos (3), etc. But we need 6 teams; top 6 teams by win count: Steelers, Patriots, 49ers, Cowboys, Packers, Giants. Or if tie: Steelers & Patriots both 6, 49ers & Cowboys 5, Packers & Giants 4.

But maybe they want 6 teams with highest wins: Steelers, Patriots, 49ers, Cowboys, Packers, Giants.

Now current head coaches as of 2025-10-31: Steelers: Mike Tomlin. Patriots: Bill Belichick. 49ers: Kyle Shanahan. Cowboys: Mike McCarthy. Packers: Matt LaFleur. Giants: Brian Daboll? Actually Giants head coach is Brian Daboll (since 2022). But check: Giants last coach was Brian Daboll; yes.

But we should confirm if there were any changes after 2025-10-31: The 2025 season? Unknown. But likely still these.

We should answer concisely: Steelers – Mike Tomlin; Patriots – Bill Belichick; 49ers – Kyle Shanahan; Cowboys – Mike McCarthy; Packers – Matt LaFleur; Giants – Brian Daboll.

Also include the Super Bowl wins count maybe.

We should be correct. Let's deliver.
